item.title: (1965) The Beach Boys Today!
item.description: Side B of this record is where Brian Wilson stops being the leader of a surf pop group and becomes a composer.

item.title: (1983) Madonna
item.description: Madonna is the debut studio album by Madonna, released on July 27, 1983, by Sire.

item.title: (1984) Like a Virgin
item.description: Like a Virgin is the second studio album by Madonna, released on November 12, 1984, by Sire.

item.title: (1992) Erotica
item.description: Erotica is the fifth studio album by Madonna, released on October 19, 1992, in the United Kingdom and on October 20, 1992, in the United States by Maverick and Sire.

item.title: (1998) Ray of Light
item.description: Ray of Light is the seventh studio album by Madonna, released on March 3, 1998, by Maverick and Warner Bros.

item.title: Madonna
item.description: Madonna’s first single reached record stores with no picture of Madonna on it.

item.title: (1986) True Blue
item.description: True Blue is the third studio album by Madonna, released on June 30, 1986, by Sire.

item.title: (1989) Like a Prayer
item.description: Like a Prayer is the fourth studio album by Madonna, released on March 21, 1989, by Sire.

item.title: Classical music
